skills.name: 谦逊
skills.officialText: 当一张锦囊牌对你生效时，若此牌名未记录且你不是使用者，则你记录之，然后可将至多X张牌置于你的武将牌上（X为“谦逊”记录的牌名数且至多为5）；若如此做，此回合结束时，你获得武将牌上的所有牌。出牌阶段开始时，你可移去一个记录的牌名，若为普通锦囊牌的牌名，则你可视为使用此牌。

skills.name: 连营
skills.officialText: 身份、团战：其他角色的回合结束时，你可观看牌堆顶的x张牌，然后将这些牌交给任意角色（x为你本回合失去的牌数，且至多为5）。斗地主：其他角色的回合结束时，你可观看牌堆顶的x张牌，然后将这些牌交给任意角色（x为你本回合失去的牌数+1，且至多为5）。

implementationContract: Current official hero and API provide matching complete texts. The first-release notice confirms the permanent general and availability date; it does not reproduce the complete skills. The later mode-pool notice is not a skill revision.

Qianxun records the effective trick name at the real per-target effect boundary only when this holder is not its actual user and that name is absent. The name is recorded before the holder may select zero through min(recorded count,5) actual owned cards. The standard owned Hand and Equipment interpretation is an engineering ruling, not an official FAQ; held and private piles are excluded.

Selected originals use the existing native private-turn hold and actual-turn return. Losing the source does not erase an already paid hold. The same whole actual-turn ending returns its originals through native movement and child windows.

At the holder own Play start, removing a recorded name pays that name before any optional native ordinary-trick Use. The Use has no physical materials, retains normal target and prohibition rules, and uses native nullification, effects and parent returns. A delayed trick name may be removed but is not an ordinary-trick Use.

Delayed effects identify the original actual user from the real card Use and actor replacement facts, rather than the delayed-effect placeholder actor. Native placement without a Use is not given a fabricated user.

Lianying counts actual physical losses in the current whole actual turn from owned Hand, Equipment and Judgment. Repeated losses of the same entity are separate real losses. At another living role actual-turn ending, the holder may privately reserve up to five real stock-top entities, then give each original to any living recipient, including self. These are real obtain movements rather than a Draw operation.

Every currently runnable mode follows the official identity/team branch. The full Landlord plus-one branch is preserved in the source text, but the project does not currently expose a formal Landlord mode; it is not inferred from player count or Lord identity.

The private look and native distribution keep their exact entity list and cursor on the owning program frame. Movement and recovery/death/source children drain before the next gift. Native terminal and beneficiary-death cutoffs remain in force.

For a real physical Wenhe Chaos trick, Qianxun enters at each actually affected native actor before that actor is asked for the nearest Slash. Its typed return freezes the original card Use, actual actor and owning Wenhe program cursor. The same-named round rule has no card Use and does not create a trick-effect record. This integration follows the native activity protocol and is not asserted to be an official character-specific FAQ.
